info.title: OpsDesk HTTP API
info.summary: Everything the OpsDesk UI can do, for curl and scripts.
info.description:
Local, single-user API of the OpsDesk bookmarks dashboard.

**Versioning:** the stable contract lives under `/api/v1`. The unversioned `/api` prefix is an alias of the current version used by the bundled UI. Within `v1` changes are backwards compatible (new endpoints, optional fields, new enum values on responses); anything breaking would appear as `/api/v2`.

**Authentication:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, token configured on the server (`OPSDESK_API_TOKEN`). Changing data without a valid token is refused. Reads are anonymous on localhost.

**Out of scope on purpose (not available through this API):** selecting the database engine, database credentials, the API token itself, file-system paths, process control, arbitrary SQL, and any deployment setting.

get.description:
Green/yellow/red health with database, storage and migration checks. HTTP 200 for green and yellow, **503** for red. The write probe runs in a rolled-back transaction: this GET never changes data. Bookmarked services are never probed.

**Authentication:** none.

**Idempotency:** safe (never changes data).

Used by the web UI (CSRF token, data locations). **Not an API credential**: the CSRF token only works together with a same-origin browser Origin header. CLI clients use a bearer token instead.

**Authentication:** none on localhost (same trust as the web UI). A bearer token is accepted, and required for browser calls from another origin.

**Idempotency:** safe (never changes data).

delete.description:
**Destructive.** An empty workspace is deleted directly. A workspace that contains groups needs an explicit `mode`: `delete` removes everything inside, `move` relocates its groups to `targetId` first. Without `mode` the call fails with 409 and changes nothing. Executed in one transaction. Repeating the call after success returns 404.

**Authentication:** required - `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (token configured on the server as `OPSDESK_API_TOKEN`). The bundled web UI authenticates with its same-origin session instead.

**Idempotency:** idempotent (repeating it has the same effect as once).

get.description:
The same matching rules as the UI search: `q` is split on whitespace and every term must appear (case-insensitively) in title, description, URL, tags or owner. Omit `workspaceId` to search **all workspaces**; give it to search one. Filters combine with AND: environment matches ANY listed value, tag requires ALL listed tags, `favorite` filters pinned bookmarks. GET never changes state (it does not record an opening).

**Authentication:** none on localhost (same trust as the web UI). A bearer token is accepted, and required for browser calls from another origin.

**Idempotency:** safe (never changes data).

parameters.description: Restrict to one workspace (omit for all workspaces).

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Comma-separated environments; a bookmark matches ANY of them.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Comma-separated tags; a bookmark must have ALL of them (case-insensitive).

post.summary: Preview an import without changing anything
post.description:
Runs the real import inside a transaction that is always rolled back and reports exactly what would be added, updated, skipped or removed. **Does not modify data** (a POST only because the document is the request body). Accepts JSON or a multipart file upload (bearer clients).

**Authentication:** required - `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (token configured on the server as `OPSDESK_API_TOKEN`). The bundled web UI authenticates with its same-origin session instead.

**Idempotency:** safe (never changes data).

post.description:
A safety backup is created first (`backup` in the response), then the import runs as **one transaction**: any failure leaves existing data untouched.

**Merge** (default) adds to the dashboard: workspaces/groups match by name (case-insensitive), bookmarks by normalised URL within the group; `duplicates` chooses skip or update.

**Replace is destructive**: it deletes all current workspaces, groups and bookmarks first and requires `"confirmReplace": true`, otherwise the call fails with 400 `confirmation_required` and nothing changes. HTML imports are merge-only.

**Authentication:** required - `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (token configured on the server as `OPSDESK_API_TOKEN`). The bundled web UI authenticates with its same-origin session instead.

**Idempotency:** not idempotent - send an Idempotency-Key to retry safely.
